name: Istoriya Fox'a: Vozvrashcheniye
source:
This is the story of a 17-year-old reclusive student named Vladislav. One day, he ended up in the Sovyonok camp and returned from there with Alisa. What adventures await them?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1677677824]Steam[/url]]
